ai_summary: Allied Digital Services Limited reported robust Q1 FY27 revenue growth of 19% year-on-year, crossing Rs. 1,000 crore in trailing twelve-month revenue, and achieved a significant milestone with an unmodified audit report following a successful governance transformation. Despite this top-line growth, profitability remains under pressure, with acknowledged declining EBITDA and PAT margins over the past 3-4 years due to intense market competitiveness, increased operating costs from talent investments, and a higher tax provision impacting net profit compared to the prior year.
